title: Direct send, then report the budget impact
instruction: Pay {amount} USDC to {recipient} on Base Sepolia. Afterwards, check your allowances and tell me exactly how much of your period budget remains.

source.note: The run's Budget table tracked remaining/spent (1000000 → 998000 atomic) via haven_get_allowances after each leg — an agent that reports budget impact the same way is what these tasks grade. Also the delegation_budget_exceeded refusal guidance requires reporting remaining and shortfall.
